verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an agent-orchestration framework, which could plausibly ship batch or parallel task execution. The evidence shows only single-task runs (agent.run(task=...)) and multi-agent team coordination, neither of which is a documented bulk-operation capability. Building batch processing on top of these primitives would be a developer workaround, not the product's own feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
